newsitem.title: USA: Blue-chip stocks end lower after giving back big rally.
newsitem.headline: Blue-chip stocks end lower after giving back big rally.

text.p: Stocks fell sharply Friday, losing ground for the third straight session after Tuesday's big rally.

Based on early and unofficial data, the Dow Jones industrial average fell 53.38 points to close at 6,738.87. In the broader market, declining issues led advances by better than a 2-1 margin on moderate volume of about 418 million shares on the New York Stock Exchange.
